correctness.rationale: Every induced P4 in the two-clique matching graph uses two vertices on each shore and one selected matching bridge as its middle edge. This proves the exhaustive cograph criterion: no full bridge, or selected shore size <=1, or precisely two whole matching pairs (induced C4). Combinatorial generating functions count the no-bridge choices, singleton-shore choices with their overlap correction, and double-bridge choices. Single-vertex extension maximality gives all two-bridge four-sets, a fully selected opposite clique plus one bridge singleton, or bridge-free orientations with exclusions when a=t or b=t. Hence exact M(z) coefficients and rook graph gaps, with endpoints t=3 and absent bridge-free contributions handled. Independent direct adjacency P4 and addition-maximality enumeration for small parameter triples confirms both coefficient arrays; finite checks are not the universal proof.
